title: Current-rule replay of the original non-ML mathematics unbuilt-pair count

classifier.scope: Every canonical kind:A row paired with its declared companion; exclude only category machine-learning. Physics is outside research/plan-spec.json and excluded.
classifier.pair_rule: A pair is built only if both current library page carriers pass and both effective inventories are nonempty; every planned item is listed on its actual page; and every planned or actual page item carrier passes the item check. Any trigger marks the entire pair unbuilt.

page_rules.body_measure: trimmed source after opening YAML frontmatter block

page_inventory_rules.actual_ids: unique union of frontmatterList(source, items) and frontmatterList(source, examples)
page_inventory_rules.effective_ids: planned page.items IDs if nonempty; otherwise actual page IDs
page_inventory_rules.item_carriers_checked: unique union of effective IDs and actual page IDs

item_rules.body_measure: trimmed text after frontmatter removal and removal of lines matching ^##\s+.*$
item_rules.additional_incomplete_kinds: counterexample and false-statement are incomplete when actual kind (or planned kind fallback) and top-level proof field is not-supplied
